shape.means: chamfered corners and straight cuts; technical, urgent
square corners, a solid base; rules, institutions, structure
edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth

label.means: a folded banner with forked tails
a tilted double-ruled stamp, inked, no fill
a luggage tag tied to the part with a curved string

bubble.means: a hand-drawn uneven outline with a soft tail
a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs
a messaging-app bubble with one square corner and delivery dots

panel.means: a light sheet with a folded corner and faint rules
a solid colour block with a hard offset shadow
no fill: a double hairline with corner brackets, the title set into the rule

icon.means: the icon alone, heavier, standing on a soft ground shadow
a rosette seal, icon knocked out
a raised tile with a hard shadow, icon in colour

mark.means: a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark
a ruled box ticked by hand, the mark overflowing it
a thick tapered brush stroke, no container

texture.means: a dot screen fading out of one corner

entrance.means: panels unroll top to bottom, labels wipe, bubbles open from the speaker
things drop in and land, panels settle
things fade up gently, labels wipe like type being set

camera.means: the camera pans along a process or a row (guidance for the storyboard)
cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)
